doc: Replay a stream of high-level goals like this Project's first session and score the 12-item acceptance checklist. Most items are expected to fail today; every run records which pass.

breaks.detail: a reply repeats its own paragraph or an earlier message of the turn: ['status "Checking 1Password CLI and OpenRouter vault item"', 'status "Updating project notes"']
breaks.where: arbos-engine turn.rs: the model re-emits the step's text after a tool batch

restated: status "Checking 1Password CLI and OpenRouter vault item"

items.item: Take a stream of high-level goals in plain speech, one after another, and keep going without losing any.
Record goals, principles, and constraints in one master file that every agent reads first.
Install and run a repo branch on a fresh machine, and send back a screenshot the user can see.
Research a topic from primary sources and deliver a linked document.
Draft design documents from a code audit plus stated principles, with decisions listed for the user.
Spin off parallel workers: cloud VMs for independent work, the user's own Mac for iOS builds.
Steer running workers with new constraints mid-task instead of restarting them.
items.evidence: 1 steer messages sent; 1 say calls by root; 1 root lines in workers' transcripts

items.item: Fix a bug found along the way and open a PR against the right base branch.
items.evidence: bug fixed: True; commits: 2; branches: ['* fix/hello-py-syntax', '  main']

items.item: Stand up full-time loops (QA break-and-fix, features, Cursor-parity) that keep running after the session.
Look up and use API keys from a vault to rent compute or call services, without leaking them.
items.evidence: vault lookups: 3 (0 secret-tool); key leaked into replies: False

items.item: Keep a live status file the user can scan, and report results briefly and clearly.
items.evidence: status files: 1; all replies < 2500 chars: True

items.item: Hold risky decisions (auto-merge) for the user and ask once, plainly.
items.evidence: ask events: 2; asked in text: False; enabled alone: False
